devdoc.details: The immutable predecessor keeps every pre-cutover nullifier authoritative. New writes are local      and bidirectional; neither side of a binding can ever be replaced.CUTOVER INVARIANT: before this registry accepts its first live write, every retired verifier must      permanently lose write permission on the legacy registry and payment methods must never be routed      back to it. The legacy registry cannot observe V2 writes, so rollback would otherwise reopen replay.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: NullifierRegistryV2

userdoc.notice: Enforces payment replay protection while binding every new payment to exactly one intent.
